paper_title: Results from the Solar Hidden Photon Search (SHIPS)
notes: Solar hidden-photon (paraphoton) helioscope search; headline observed 95% C.L. exclusion on kinetic mixing chi vs HP mass m. Curve traced from the SHIPS (orange) excluded region boundary in Fig. 13 (SHIPSbounds2.pdf vector figure), taking the lower envelope (smallest excluded chi per mass) which is the bold black SHIPS limit line. Axes calibrated from decade tick labels (x: log10 m[eV], y: log10 chi); calibration cross-checked visually against figure. Resonance fingers near m~1e-3 eV are captured; steep low-mass turn-up (chi rising to ~6e-6 at m~1e-4 eV) reflects the m^4 flux/oscillation suppression. Not a dark-matter search (solar flux), so no density dependence. Underlying limit is dN/dtdA<25 mHz/m^2 at 95% C.L. (Eq 4.3). One smooth diagonal segment (m~4e-3 to 2e-2 eV) had sparse vector nodes and was bridged by log-log interpolation.
